newsitem.title: USA: Alcatel wins $50 mln Sprint contract.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel wins $50 mln Sprint contract.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom Cie Generale d'Electricite affiliate Alcatel Telecom said it won a contract worth $50 million over three years from Sprint Corp to provide local SONET (synchronous optical network) equipment for Sprint's local U.S. telephone operations.
The equipment will primarily consist of Alcatel 1648 SM and Alcatel 1603/12 SM SONET multiplexers, Alcatel said.

The company did not say how much the multiplexers cost to produce or when it would begin delivering them. The company also did not say when, or to what extent, the $50 million contract will affect its earnings.
Alcatel officials were not immediately available to comment.
